official: 東京都板橋区乳児等通園支援事業の設備及び運営に関する基準を定める条例の一部を改正する条例

sources.label: 議案の審査状況（令和8年第1回定例会）
令和8年第1回定例会 議案等に対する審査結果

name: 特例保育事業所に基準の適用特例を設ける
summary: 区の条例は、乳児等通園支援事業所の設備や運営などの基準を定めています。改正後は、特例保育を行う事業者が同じ事業所で一般型乳児等通園支援事業を行う場合、第21条と第22条の設備・職員基準を適用しません。事業所の呼び方や定員などに関する規定も整え、原則として令和8年4月1日から施行します。
changes: 特例保育の事業所で一般型乳児等通園支援事業を行う場合、第21条と第22条の設備・職員基準を適用しない
利用定員の意味を子ども・子育て支援法に基づく確認で定める定員として明記する
事業所や職員などに関する規定の表現を整える
who: 特例保育を行い、同じ事業所で一般型乳児等通園支援事業も行う事業者
why: 内閣府令の改正に伴い、特例保育を行う事業所の設備・職員基準の特例を定め、必要な規定を整えるためと、区は説明しています。

en.name: Creates an exception to standards for special-case childcare facilities
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Ordinance Establishing Standards for the Facilities and Operation of Child Attendance Support Services for Infants and Other Children in Itabashi City, Tokyo
en.summary: The ward's ordinance sets standards for the facilities and operation of services supporting childcare attendance for infants and other children. After the amendment, when a provider offering special-case childcare also provides the general-type service at the same establishment, the facility and staffing standards in Articles 21 and 22 will not apply. The amendment also revises provisions on terminology for establishments and capacity, among other things, and generally takes effect on April 1, 2026.
changes: Exempt providers offering special-case childcare from the facility and staffing standards in Articles 21 and 22 when they provide the general-type service at the same establishment
Specify that the capacity for use means the capacity set in the confirmation under the Act on Child and Child-rearing Support
Revise wording in provisions concerning establishments, staff and other matters
who: Providers that offer special-case childcare and also provide the general-type service at the same establishment
en.why: The ward says this is to establish an exception to the facility and staffing standards for establishments offering special-case childcare, in response to an amendment to a Cabinet Office Order, and to make necessary adjustments to the provisions.
